To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the pion is a point-like particle, the strange quark is heavy and that the nucleon is a point-like object.

(1) the pion and nucleon form factors are now well understood, (2) the nucleon electromagnetic form factors are now known at high precision in the spacelike region and (3) the pion form factors can be calculated at the physical pion mass, but not yet with high precision.

(a) lattice results for the strange quark mass, m_s, are now in excellent agreement with the continuum limit of the experimental value, (b) the strange quark radius is now known to be negative, (c) the strange quarks are not distributed uniformly within the nucleon, (d) there is evidence that the strange quark distribution is asymmetric with respect to the center of the nucleon.

hadron structure, in particular with nucleon structure.
a few selected aspects of hadron structure, in particular, the structure of the nucleon, the pion, and the kaon, which are studied by means of QCD on the lattice.
the structure of the hadron, in particular, the nucleon.
